sentences.en: Welcome to ADSP, the podcast episode 308 recorded on October 7th, 2026.

sentences.en: My name is Connor.

sentences.en: And today with my co-host, Ben, we chat with Jason Turner in part two of this three-part conversation.

sentences.en: In today's episode, we talk about Jason Turner's rule of N talk that he gave both at CPPCon and NDC TechTown.

sentences.en: The talk?

sentences.zh: 我基本上是想对零法则和五法则做一个现代化的更新，对吧？

sentences.en: And like, well, okay, Ben, you don't like, I think this is fair to say, you don't like things that are default constructible.
sentences.zh: 而且，好吧，本，你不太喜欢——我觉得这样说很公道——你不太喜欢默认可构造的东西。

sentences.en: Is that a safe-ish?

sentences.en: I don't like, I was thinking about this this morning in preparation for our conversation today.

sentences.en: And yeah, let's go with that.

sentences.en: I have a whole lot to say on that, but let's, yeah, let's park that for a minute.

sentences.en: So at the very least, you have opinions and you think, look, if your thing's going to be default constructible, there should be a reason why it's default constructible.
sentences.zh: 所以至少，你有你的看法，你认为：听着，如果你的东西要做到默认可构造，那它就应该有理由支持默认可构造。

sentences.en: Is that fair?

sentences.en: I think that's fair.

sentences.en: For sure.

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: But most people don't even don't think about default constructibility, right?
sentences.zh: 但大多数人甚至根本不会去考虑默认可构造性，对吧？

sentences.en: So I'm just like, okay, so let's talk about, let's take it to the rule of six, right?

sentences.zh: 你不喜欢……如果你去看看霍华德·

sentences.en: And you know, okay, so I just thought I would do that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，好吧，所以我当时就想这么做。

sentences.en: And then I'm like, well, like, I kind of want to make sure that I, I forget what road I went

sentences.en: So for the sake of our listeners, if you write a destructor, copy constructor, move constructor, copy assignment, or move assignment operator, then those impact the
sentences.zh: 所以为了我们的听众着想，如果你编写了析构函数、拷贝构造函数、移动构造函数、拷贝赋值或移动赋值运算符，那么这些就会影响

sentences.en: other special member functions that are generated.
sentences.zh: 生成的其他特殊成员函数。

sentences.en: So if you provide a copy operation, then the compiler does not generate for you the move operations.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你提供了拷贝操作，编译器就不会为你生成移动操作。

sentences.en: But if you provide the move operations, one or the other, then the copy operations are implicitly deleted.
sentences.zh: 但如果你提供了移动操作（无论是哪一个），拷贝操作就会被隐式删除。

sentences.en: And there's like a big difference between not provided and deleted, right?
sentences.zh: 而且“未提供”和“被删除”之间有很大的区别，对吧？

sentences.en: Like this, anyhow, so I started to go down this rabbit hole.
sentences.zh: 就像这样，总之，我开始陷入这个钻牛角尖的深渊。

sentences.en: And I'm like, well, what are all the different signatures that the compiler thinks is a copy?
sentences.zh: 然后我就想，编译器认为属于拷贝的各种不同签名都有哪些？

sentences.en: One of the special member functions?

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.zh: 我想现在我得仔细核对一下，那是……我必须，哦糟了，我得回去查查我的数字。

sentences.en: Because there are, so just to restate what you just said, there are, for example, considering copy construction.
sentences.zh: 因为，重申一下你刚才所说的话，例如，在考虑拷贝构造时。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: There are, you can write the copy constructor signature in potentially a number of different
sentences.zh: 你可以用许多不同的方式来编写

sentences.en: ways that the compiler will, will know that yes, this is considered the copy constructor.
sentences.zh: 拷贝构造函数的签名，而编译器会识别出：是的，这被视为拷贝构造函数。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the copy constructor itself has, well, if you, you can, you can default arguments on the copy constructor.
sentences.zh: 拷贝构造函数本身有……如果你可以，你可以为拷贝构造函数设置默认参数。

sentences.en: Let's just throw that topic away because you have infinitely many copy constructors if you can default them.
sentences.zh: 我们还是把这个话题抛开吧，因为如果你能设置默认参数，你就会拥有无限多的拷贝构造函数。

sentences.en: So whatever, ignore that.
sentences.zh: 所以管他呢，忽略这个。

sentences.en: But most people don't know that there are actually, oh crap, I'm going to get these numbers wrong.
sentences.zh: 但大多数人不知道实际上有……哦糟糕，我的数字可能会搞错。

sentences.en: There's a lot of signatures that are count as distinct overloads that the compiler will count as copy constructor.
sentences.zh: 有大量的签名，它们被算作不同的重载，编译器会把它们当作拷贝构造函数来计算。

sentences.en: So it is, it is non-const reference, which no one thinks about of the same type.
sentences.zh: 所以它是，它是非常非常少有人会想到的、相同类型的非常量引用。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: The parameter is a non-const reference.
sentences.zh: 参数是一个非常量引用。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Non-const reference, which is famous.
sentences.zh: 非常量引用，这很有名。

sentences.en: So the regular one is the parameters are const reference.
sentences.zh: 所以常规的那种，参数是常量引用。

sentences.en: That would be the one most people reach for.
sentences.zh: 那将是大多数人最先使用的。

sentences.en: That's what most people would reach for, but the compiler is willing to generate one for you that takes a non-const reference.

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Oh, right.

sentences.en: No one thinks about that, right?
sentences.zh: 没有人会想到这一点，对吧？

sentences.en: So non-const reference, const reference, volatile reference, const volatile reference.
sentences.zh: 所以非常量引用、常量引用、易变引用、常量易变引用。

sentences.en: Those are the valid copy constructor signatures, the things that are actually different overloads, right?
sentences.zh: 这些是有效的拷贝构造函数签名，也就是实际属于不同重载的东西，对吧？

sentences.en: And right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Move construct, but that can be expressed also as a template perhaps.
sentences.zh: 移动构造，但也许也可以将其表达为一个模板。

sentences.en: So there are other ways to write.
sentences.zh: 所以还有其他编写方式。

sentences.en: No, if you make it a template, then it does not impact the rule of five.
sentences.zh: 不，如果你把它写成模板，它就不会影响五法则。

sentences.en: It has to be a non-template function.
sentences.zh: 它必须是一个非模板函数。

sentences.en: As far as the generation of the other special elements.
sentences.zh: 就其他特殊成员的生成而言。

sentences.en: It can be no accept or otherwise.
sentences.zh: 它可以是 noexcept 或者其他形式。

sentences.en: It can be no accept, but that is a distinct type, but that does not affect overload resolution.
sentences.zh: 它可以是 noexcept，那是一个不同的类型，但这不会影响重载决议。

sentences.en: So I kind of tried to focus a little bit on like what things specifically affect overload resolution.
sentences.zh: 所以我试图稍微专注于具体有哪些东西会影响重载决议。

sentences.en: But if you include a no accept, okay.

sentences.en: So I don't know how far we want to go into this, but like spoiler alert for the copy assignment operator, that if you include also constexpr, consteval, no accept, and I think no

sentences.zh: 拼写拷贝赋值运算符的方式足足有 320 种不同的写法，编译器会把它们都算作你提供了一个拷贝赋值运算符。

sentences.en: And like, what?

sentences.en: Right.

sentences.zh: 即使不算那些限定符带来的乘法级增长，也还有十几种甚至更多，对吧？

sentences.zh: 所以对于拷贝赋值运算符，你的选择有：按值传递、常量引用、按值传递、按引用传递、常量引用、易变引用或常量易变引用。

sentences.en: That's for the parameter, right?

sentences.en: The right-hand side of the argument.

sentences.en: But you can also reference, you can L value reference, or R value reference, qualify it.
sentences.zh: 但你也可以加上引用限定，你可以用左值引用或右值引用来对其进行限定。

sentences.en: So that's three different states there because unqualified L value or R value reference qualified.
sentences.zh: 所以这里有三种不同的状态，因为可以是不限定、左值引用限定或右值引用限定。

sentences.en: You were getting to the point that aside from special members now, since C++ 20 and seemingly
sentences.zh: 你刚才正要说到，除了特殊成员之外，自从 C++20 以来，并且似乎

sentences.zh: 接下去，编译器现在能够生成更多的函数，比如 Equality、Spaceship，或者像后置自增，这是在 C++26 还是 29 中？
